# H early vs late

## The heuristic

**Escalating early costs credibility; escalating late costs the account. If you genuinely cannot tell which side of the line you are on, you are already late.**


_Why:_ The two costs are not felt symmetrically. Looking premature is immediate, personal and lands on the agent; losing the account is delayed, diffuse and lands on someone else. Untrained judgement therefore drifts late in a way that feels like prudence, and the tie breaker exists to correct a known bias rather than to describe a real balance point.
